LIMITATION (stated per R3, not a finding): fragment ordering/connectivity was not established, so no two-point distance here should be read as a route length; a bbox diagonal only bounds the extent of that ID's fragments. Example of why this matters: an ID whose fragments run in two directions along a mountain pass can show a bbox diagonal much larger than the straight road distance between its two ends would suggest, because the bbox also captures the perpendicular spread between opposite-direction carriageways.
